data.current_summary: Create a chart card from a query or your own data
data.current_description: Ask in plain words («blue dollar this week», «standings last Formula 1 race», «elections in Brazil», «Milei vs Bullrich coverage», «news in The Guardian this week», «prices in my catalog» with `index`). It first works out what you expect to see (`interpretation`, with other readings you can ask for), then gets that data: the finishing positions of the latest race, poll or result shares, wins in the season, coverage, tone, outlets, a timeline or the figures the articles publish, verified against the sources. It never fails while there are articles on the topic: if the exact data is not published or takes too long, it shows the closest thing (`rung`: exact, partial, related, coverage, stories) with a warning, and a stored chart keeps `improving` until the exact data arrives. With `stream: true`, server-sent events: `step`, `result` and `improved`. Or send `data` (series, events, or columns and rows) and it picks the chart, sorts, summarizes and titles it. `type` forces one of 12 types while the data allows. From a query it costs its search (the mode it ended in, one per compared name; free if cached) plus the chart add-on; from your data, the data price (see `x-pricing`, per_1000_charts). The same request within 10 minutes returns the same card, free. No articles at all: 422 `insufficient_data`, not billed.
data.summary_suggestion: Generate an embeddable chart card from news query or custom data
data.description_suggestion: Creates an embeddable chart card by either: (1) accepting a natural language query (e.g., 'blue dollar this week', 'Formula 1 standings', 'elections in Brazil') and automatically determining the appropriate chart type and data extraction, or (2) accepting custom data (series, events, or columns/rows) and automatically selecting the optimal chart type. Supports streaming with `stream: true` for real-time updates via server-sent events (step, result, improved). Returns a chart card with interpretation, data rung level (exact, partial, related, coverage, stories), and continues improving as data arrives. Caches results for 10 minutes. Pricing: from query (search mode cost + $0.50 per 1,000 charts), from data ($0.30 per 1,000 charts). Returns 422 `insufficient_data` if no relevant articles found (not billed).

data.current_summary: Search the index for one topic, or up to five
data.current_description: When the index has fewer than 3 good matches for a single query, discovery looks for sources beyond it within a time budget (3 s in normal, 8 s in deep; ultra and fast add at most 0.8 s: the open news index and one relevance check, the rest keeps learning in the background): outlets proposed by a topic model and by an open news index, read at the original site with robots.txt respected and judged by the same relevance model; in deep, also the search that those sites declare, with a topic keyword. Discovered results come with `found_in: discovery`; `discovery` says what it did and `incomplete` whether the time ran out. With stream: true, index results arrive first and discovered ones in later partial events. Open news index built from the GDELT Project (gdeltproject.org).
data.summary_suggestion: Search news index by topic with optional discovery
data.description_suggestion: Searches the news index for articles matching one to five topics. When fewer than 3 matches are found, automatically discovers additional sources from the open news index and relevant outlets within a configurable time budget (3s normal, 8s deep, 0.8s ultra/fast). Returns ranked articles with relevance scores. Discovered results are marked with `found_in: discovery`. Supports streaming responses with `stream: true` to receive index results first, followed by discovered results. Respects robots.txt when crawling source sites.
